caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average rate of model attention allocated to different input segments during generation, categorized as context, generated response, and other. The horizontal axis represents two comparison categories: "Ours" and "Standard," while the vertical axis displays the rate, labeled as percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 70% and tick labels at increments of 10%. For the "Ours" category, three bars are present, colored blue, orange, and green, representing context (60.6%), generated response (31.7%), and other (7.7%) respectively. In the "Standard" category, the bars are similarly colored to denote context (23.6%), generated response (51.1%), and other (25.3%). The bars are sorted alphabetically within each comparison category. The "Context" bars appear visually distinct due to a darker blue shade. The shortest bars in the chart are the green "Other" bars, with a value of 7.7% for "Ours" and 25.3% for "Standard," while the tallest bars are the blue "Context" bars with a value of 60.6% for "Ours" and 23.6% for "Standard".
